_comment: Integration starting points only. Legacy verdict values are not measured readiness or migration recommendations. Verify current framework and platform docs plus actual runtime behavior.

nextjs.notes: Inspect current routing, script placement, consent, and server routes. Verify supported helpers in the installed framework version; do not assume a MetaPixel helper exists. Measure script cost and conversion delivery.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

astro.notes: Inspect rendered content and optional worker-based script integrations. Test each vendor's compatibility and consent behavior before moving scripts off the main thread; static rendering does not guarantee good CWV.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

sveltekit.notes: Inspect browser-only initialization, navigation tracking, and server endpoints. Confirm adapter capabilities and actual event delivery.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

remix.notes: Inspect root script placement, navigation tracking, and server actions. Confirm runtime support and actual conversion delivery.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

nuxt.notes: Inspect head handling, client initialization, router events, and server endpoints. Verify maintained integrations against the installed versions.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

vite-spa.notes: A SPA can support ad tracking and good CWV. Inspect initial load, client navigation, consent, and deduplication. Measure performance; consider selective prerendering or SSR only for demonstrated problems, not as a prerequisite for tracking.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

vue.notes: Inspect the actual renderer and router rather than inferring readiness from Vue. Confirm navigation events, consent, and measured performance. No presumed migration ROI.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

gatsby.notes: Inspect rendered output, maintained tracking integrations, hydration, and the actual hosting/build setup. Measure before recommending changes.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

wordpress.notes: Inspect active theme/plugin behavior, duplicate tags, consent, caching, and measured script cost. Plugin count alone cannot prove poor performance.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

shopify.notes: Inspect current supported pixel integrations and privacy behavior, including checkout restrictions. Confirm platform documentation and test the installed theme or headless implementation; neither architecture guarantees performance.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation

webflow.notes: Inspect supported custom-code settings, consent behavior, event delivery, and any external server-side conversion integration. Verify current plan capabilities before declaring a missing feature.
best_for: evaluate the user's selected ad platforms and actual implementation
